title: Console backend: config version history + compare endpoints (with caching + permission checks)
author: Felix Schneider
description: Summary: Adds Console-facing backend endpoints to power the Optimize Config Version History timeline and the Compare view. This PR also adds basic response caching for the most common list/history reads and enforces RBAC permissions for all new routes. Motivation: The Console UI needs a stable, paginated API for (a) listing versions by scope (customer/region/cluster/model/route) with metadata and (b) fetching a pair of versions to render a diff preview. The control plane APIs exist, but the Console backend needs to: (1) normalize shapes for the UI, (2) enforce Console permission semantics (tenant-aware RBAC), (3) apply safe caching to reduce load during incidents when everyone is refreshing history/compare. What’s included (endpoints): 1) GET /console/optimize/config-versions: List versions for a given scope. Supports filters: scope_type, scope_id, route_id, model, region, environment, author, created_after/created_before. Pagination: cursor-based (before/after) with stable ordering (created_at DESC, version_id DESC). Response includes: version_id, version_number, created_at, author_user_id, source (console/api/system), reason, linked_ticket, applied_state (best-effort), and summary fields used by the timeline. 2) GET /console/optimize/config-versions/:versionId: Fetch a single version including full config blob (redacted fields), plus metadata used for the right-hand details drawer. 3) POST /console/optimize/config-versions/compare: Accepts {left_version_id, right_version_id} and returns a normalized diff payload suitable for UI rendering (sections: batching, caching, quantization, routing, guardrails) with per-field changed/added/removed and a small set of computed “risk flags” (e.g., batch_size increased, quantization profile changed). Notes: This intentionally does NOT perform preflight validation; it’s a pure compare surface. Caching: - Adds a small Redis-backed cache layer for list + get endpoints (compare remains uncached for now due to combinatorics; we may revisit once UI usage patterns are clearer). - Default TTLs: list=10s, get=30s. - Cache keys include tenant_id, actor_role_hash (derived from RBAC grants), and a normalized scope filter hash to avoid cross-permission leakage. - Adds ETag support for GET endpoints (Console can send If-None-Match; we return 304 when unchanged). Permissions: - New checks are wired to existing permission names (no new permission strings introduced here): requires optimize.config.read for list/get/compare. (If a tenant has only rollback/apply but not read, that’s a misconfig; Kaitlyn called out we should keep read as the prerequisite for Console pages.) - Dedicated/Private tenants: scope resolution enforces tenant boundary, and refuses “global” scopes unless the actor has internal_admin. Data handling / redaction: - Config payload returned from GET :versionId is passed through the existing redaction pipeline used by optimize config reads (secrets/keys removed; internal-only fields omitted). - author_user_id is returned; author email is not returned. Testing: - Adds integration tests for pagination stability, tenant isolation, and permission denial (403) for missing optimize.config.read. - Adds a cache correctness test verifying cache key includes actor_role_hash and tenant_id. - Adds E2E-ish API test for compare normalization (ensures diff output stable for nested knobs). Operational notes: - This is behind feature flag console.optimizeConfigHistory (default off). - Adds metrics: console_optimize_config_versions_list_latency_ms, console_optimize_config_versions_cache_hit_total, console_optimize_config_versions_cache_miss_total, console_optimize_config_versions_forbidden_total. - Adds structured logs with request_id + scope identifiers (no config content logged). Checklist: - [x] Integration tests - [x] RBAC enforcement on all routes - [x] Caching keys include tenant + permissions - [x] Flagged rollout - [x] Metrics + dashboards hooks (basic) Follow-ups: - Consider caching compare results once we see real usage (likely keyed on (left,right,tenant,rolehash) with short TTL). - Wire applied_state to rollout status API once ENG-4827 status reporting is stable (currently best-effort via latest apply record).
commits: Commits (squash merged): 1) console-backend: add optimize config versions router + handlers 2) console-backend: normalize list response + cursor pagination helpers 3) console-backend: add compare endpoint + diff normalization 4) rbac: enforce optimize.config.read in console optimize routes 5) cache: redis wrapper + etag support for config version endpoints 6) tests: integration coverage for history/compare + permission/caching
review_conversation: Chloe Martin (review): Pagination looks good; two nits: (1) ensure stable ordering includes a tie-breaker if created_at equal, (2) compare endpoint should validate both version_ids belong to same tenant/scope to prevent weird UI state. Felix Schneider (author): Added version_id DESC as tie-breaker; added tenant + scope equality checks in compare handler (returns 400 with code=SCOPE_MISMATCH). Dylan Brooks (review): Can we keep response shape aligned with the UI timeline model? UI expects source + linked_ticket consistently. Also please keep the body free of internal-only fields; we’ve been burned by accidental leakage in Console APIs. Felix: Updated serializer to always include source (default=api) and linked_ticket (nullable). Confirmed redaction pipeline applied on GET :versionId only; list endpoint never returns config blobs. Kaitlyn Nguyen (review): RBAC: Do not cache across permission sets. Also 403 vs 404 semantics: for missing permission return 403, for cross-tenant access return 404 to avoid enumeration. Felix: Cache keys now include actor_role_hash; cross-tenant access returns 404; missing optimize.config.read returns 403. Added tests for both. Allison Grant (review): TTLs seem fine, but list caching at 10s may hide rapid incident changes; please add metrics for cache hit rate and include a cache-bypass header for on-call if needed. Felix: Added metrics + a supported header X-Console-Cache-Bypass: 1 (internal-only; requires internal_admin). Documented in route docstring. Chloe (final): Looks good. Please keep compare uncached for now; we can revisit after we see load. Approved. Dylan (final): Approved; nice job on role-aware caching.
release_notes: Console backend now supports Optimize config version history + compare API endpoints (flagged: console.optimizeConfigHistory). Includes Redis caching + ETag support and RBAC enforcement requiring optimize.config.read.
